facts.fact: The Ministry of Telecommunications, Digital Economy and Digitalization of Administration of Chad, with ECA and GIZ, held stakeholder consultations on 13-15 May 2026 in N'Djamena for the National Data Governance Strategy, followed by a 21 May workshop to validate the findings; the page lists private sector, academia, civil society organisations, telecom operators and fintech companies among the participants (announced attendance).
